text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru has been weighed down with fatigue, so I decide to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pshhh! Leave this to me! Resting is one of my best talents, second only to divination!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it is! Anyway, good night!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This feels so mystical… It can only be the work of Shiraoki! What do you request of me, my great?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Something fell just now! What's this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's a daruma doll!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That brings back memories… The great Shiraoki offered me one of these in a dream.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that gift, I didn't give up after that track and field event, even though I got last place…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And even though it hurt when my sister won… that doll made it hurt just a little less! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was such a crybaby back then… Now I stay positive and keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just like Shiraoki said! "The more you run, the more possibilities will come upon you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that dream just now brought back some good memories. This is definitely a sign of good luck to come!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I'm full of energy! O Shiraoki, I still have a ton more races left in me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Isn't this the test I failed the other day?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The results were so tragic that I offered them up in a secret burning ritual… So why is it here?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You disappointing scrap of paper! To the afterlife with you! Go on, shoo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ack!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… What a terrible nightmare…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to shake off what she saw in her dream, Matikanefukukitaru does not get much rest.
